basics.name: Thang M. Pham
basics.label: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Adobe DCAI
basics.summary: Senior Machine Learning Engineer in Adobe's Document Cloud Artificial Intelligence (DCAI) team, with a Ph.D. in Computer Science from Auburn University. Work spans document intelligence, agent systems, retrieval and grounding, and evaluation for reliable production AI, with research in efficient small language models and on-device assistance.

work.name: Adobe
work.summary: Document Cloud Artificial Intelligence (DCAI): document intelligence, agent systems, grounded answers, and production reliability.
highlights: Work on retrieval, context selection, and harness-supported tool use for document intelligence and agent systems.
Evaluate evidence-backed answers through controlled comparisons of quality, responsiveness, and resource use.
Trace failures across the system, carrying issues through diagnosis, implementation, and verification.
Build for shared ownership through self-service workflows, knowledge sharing, and correctness-focused code review.

work.name: Creative Intelligence Lab, Adobe Inc.
work.summary: Researched efficient small language models for on-device document assistance, published as SlimLM at ACL 2025 (System Demonstrations).
highlights: Evaluated trade-offs among model size, context length, and on-device inference time.
Studied document summarization, question answering, and question suggestion on mobile devices.
Developed an Android demonstration for on-device document assistance.

work.name: Creative Intelligence Lab, Adobe Inc.
work.summary: Worked on LLMs for image editing
highlights: Researched language-model planning and tool use for image-editing tasks.
Constructed instruction-following and preference data for evaluating model behavior.
Fine-tuned and evaluated language models for generating and executing tool-use plans.

work.name: Creative Intelligence Lab, Adobe Inc.
work.summary: Worked on phrase representation and semantic search
highlights: Researched contextual phrase representations and semantic search.
Developed dataset and benchmark methods for phrase understanding, published as PiC at EACL 2023.
Fine-tuned and evaluated language models on phrase understanding in context.

work.name: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science & Technology
work.summary: Focused on biomedical text mining and deep learning
highlights: Developed deep learning models for biomedical NER and event extraction
Implemented novel neural networks for NER tasks
Optimized parallel computing with multiple GPUs
